text:
eva: FYI bringing up hf/model-7b-quant on Redwood Dedicated. Seeing streaming replies cut off when the HF chat template includes an extra separator token. Repro attached below.

tyler: :eyes: can you paste the chat template + config.json fragment?

eva: repro snippet: 
```
system: You are helpful.
user: Tell me a short poem.
assistant: 
```
Output (streaming): 'Roses are red\nViolets are blue<|endoftext>' and then stream stops mid-sentence sometimes.

maria: hmm. Are you sure that's the HF eos token or an extra special token in additional_special_tokens?

eva: config.json has "eos_token": "", and tokenizer.json lists "added_tokens": ["",""], and chat_template has a trailing "\nassistant:" line. HF conversion script appears to map both to Redwood EOS handling and then we get double markers.

dennis: I've seen early termination when the runtime treats ANY sentinel token as immediate stop in streaming. If HF template appends an _empty_ sentinel it can produce an empty segment that looks like EOS. Could be whitespace-only tokenization causing a zero-length token that triggers stop.

tyler: can you run this quick check: call generate with streaming and set stop=["\nassistant:"] vs stop=[""] . See differences.

eva: did that. With stop=["\nassistant:"] replies stream fully. With stop=[""] most streams cut at first sentinel even if tokens remain.

maria: possible root cause: HF tokenizers sometimes add multiple sentinel tokens (one internal, one in added_tokens) and our HF->Redwood conversion merged them into a single canonical eos id but left an extra mapping in chat template text. When streaming we interpret any eos id occurrence as terminal even if it's part of a multi-token sequence that should be collapsed.

dennis: quick mitigation: change conversion to collapse consecutive eos ids into one logical event for streaming, and prefer explicit stop strings over token id stops for chat templates.

eva: can we hotfix conversion script on staging? I can throw a unit test. Reproducer in python: 
```
from redwood_client import stream_generate
prompt = "system: You are helpful.\nuser: One line please.\nassistant:"
# this model has both '' as eos and an extra added token mapping
stream_generate(model='hf/model-7b-quant', prompt=prompt, stop=[''])
```
Streams end after the first '' emission not after full sentence.

tyler: ok. I'll change hf_conversion.py to detect duplicate sentinel tokens in config.json and in chat templates and normalize to a single sentinel string. Also add a test for whitespace tokens that tokenize to empty string sequences.

ci-bot: deploy queued — branch=fix/eos-collapse, target=staging, pr=4523 :rocket:

maria: one more ask: add logging in runtime to print token ids when stop triggers so we can see whether it's a single eos id or a multi-token pattern. That will help rule out tokenizer vs runtime.

eva: good plan. I'll add the failing stdout capture to the unit test and post results once staging deploys. Thanks all :thumbsup:
